description.value: A Victoria e-bike specialist with over 16 years in the local cycling community, carrying brands like Specialized, Kona, and Moustache across city, cargo, road, gravel, and mountain categories. They run a full-service repair department that handles all makes and models of e-bikes, and stock a broad range of parts and accessories. The shop also organizes social group rides and offers free coached test rides.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Victoria Electric Bikes is a full-service e-bike shop at 1023 Cook St with phone (778) 432-0255. The service page states 'We operate a full-service department' and 'We service all makes and models of e-bikes,' confirming repair capability and e-bike service. They stock a wide parts/accessories range including tubes, tires, pumps, tools, racks/baskets, fenders, and lighting — relevant to touring cyclists. 'Social Rides' appears in the footer nav and 'Join Us For a Ride' on the front page, but these appear to be community group rides rather than guided touring rides.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Established full-service bike shop with repair department, broad parts inventory, and e-bike expertise — clearly useful to touring cyclists passing through Victoria.

Touring parts stocked.detail: Stocks tubes, tires, pumps, tools/maintenance, fenders, lighting, locks, packs/racks/baskets, saddles, pedals, seatposts
